goal: stackless-launch: Take stackless (github.com/snowmead/stackless) from a working v0 codebase to a product AI agents can adopt and use end to end, unassisted. Everything done, including releases. Every surface gears toward adoption by agents, not humans: skills, CLI ergonomics, machine-readable data and docs. HARD COST CONSTRAINT: assign only these budget models to every task you spawn, at every level (workers, subplanners, verifiers): composer-2.5 (default; use for all code and most tasks), kimi-k2.7-code, or glm-5.2. Never assign opus-, gpt-, sonnet-, or codex-class models regardless of what the skill's model catalog recommends; this instruction overrides the catalog defaults. Done means: (1) installable releases, a tagged release via the existing cargo-dist setup with prebuilt binaries and a one-line install; (2) an agent skill plugin (SKILL.md) that teaches an agent to install stackless, author a stackless.toml for an arbitrary repo, and drive the full lifecycle (up/verify/down/status/logs) branching on stable error codes and --json/NDJSON output; (3) an authoring on-ramp, either a stackless init/adopt verb or a skill-driven loop that drafts a stackless.toml and iterates with stackless check until valid; (4) a preflight/doctor path that verifies prerequisites (Docker, daemon persistence, provider keys, Stripe Projects setup) with remediation in the established error-code style; (5) a runnable public example a stranger's agent can clone and 'up --on local' immediately; (6) README and provider matrix reconciled with what is actually implemented (fly and netlify exist in code but are unchecked in the README), smoke suites green for every substrate that ships, and substrates that do not pass are dropped or gated. Non-goals per VISION.md sequencing: the secret-blind egress boundary, fleet mode, and new providers.
summary: Agent-ready stackless v0.1.0: releases, skill plugin, doctor/init, public example, docs matrix

tasks.scopedGoal: Commit a durable reference artifact at `.orchestrate/stackless-launch/REFERENCE.md` that descendants use instead of re-discovering the repo. Do not implement product features.
tasks.brief:
Write REFERENCE.md from the facts below (expand with file paths and code pointers where helpful).

## Current state (v0.1.0 workspace, no git tags yet)
- CLI verbs today: up, down, verify, status, list, logs, check, daemon (hidden). No init/adopt/doctor.
- `--json` on all user verbs; errors use schema_version=1 with stable `code`, `remediation`, optional `context`. See README Agent output section and crates/stackless/src/error.rs.
- Substrates registered: local, render, vercel, fly, netlify (crates/stackless/src/substrates.rs). README matrix still has fly and netlify unchecked.
- cargo-dist configured (dist-workspace.toml, .github/workflows/release.yml). Version 0.1.0 in Cargo.toml. No releases published yet.
- Fixtures: fixtures/hello (invalid example.invalid repo — not cloneable), fixtures/duo, fixtures/pgdemo (needs Docker postgres), fixtures/smoke/* for live cloud smokes.
- Smoke tasks: mise run smoke-{vercel,render,cloudflare,fly,netlify}; cloudflare is integration-only on local.
- ARCHITECTURE.md § mentions init --from as not yet shipped.

## Gaps vs launch goal
1. Release: tag v0.1.0, verify dist installers, document curl one-liner.
2. Agent skill: new SKILL.md (repo `.cursor/skills/stackless/` or plugin-style path) teaching install + lifecycle + error-code branching.
3. Authoring: add `stackless init` (scaffold minimal stackless.toml) OR `stackless adopt` (inspect repo and draft toml); must iterate with `stackless check`.
4. Doctor: new `stackless doctor` checking Docker, daemon ping/persistence, .stackless.env / provider tokens, stripe projects status; machine-readable like other verbs.
5. Public example: new `examples/agent-demo/` using repo-local source (file:// or relative path pattern) so `stackless up --name demo --on local --file examples/agent-demo/stackless.toml` works immediately after install.
6. Docs: check README provider matrix; gate or drop substrates failing smoke/hermetic tests.

## Conventions to match
- Read CLAUDE.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/SCHEMA.md before editing core.
- Error codes: follow existing patterns in stackless-core/src/def/error.rs, engine/error.rs, substrate faults.
- Tests: hermetic in CI via cargo nextest; live smokes gated.
- Branch naming: cursor/<task>-1f13 for feature work merging to main via PR.

## Non-goals
- Secret-blind egress, fleet mode, new providers.

Also add a short `## Task map` section listing the sibling subplanners (agent-surface, release-ship, example-docs) and what each owns.
acceptance: REFERENCE.md committed with all sections above

tasks.brief:
Own deliverables 2–4 from the root goal. Publish workers (and verifiers) for:
- Agent skill at `.cursor/skills/stackless/SKILL.md` (or `.cursor/skills/stackless/` plugin layout): install via release one-liner or cargo install, author stackless.toml using docs/SCHEMA.md, drive up/verify/down/status/logs with --json, branch on error.code never prose, document NDJSON up progress on stderr.
- CLI authoring on-ramp: prefer `stackless init` scaffolding a minimal valid toml for a detected stack type (static site, single service, etc.) plus optional `stackless adopt` that inspects repo files; both must integrate with `stackless check` for validation loop.
- `stackless doctor` verb: non-interactive checks for docker, daemon (stackless daemon ping), persistence warning path, required env from .stackless.env template, stripe projects plugin + link status when cloud substrates referenced; emit --json checklist with pass/fail per check and remediation codes matching existing error envelope style.

Keep changes surgical; run `mise run check` and relevant tests. Hand back branch list and verification notes.
